name: qkd_seq_static_s-p1-COMMIT
purpose: OWN-QWEN/KV-PARENTS 10-18 (K.STA.PARK): hardened cluster parent qkd_seq_static_s of the KV/system die (slot seq). Bench: LOCKSTEP of qkd_seq_static_s vs qkd_seq_static_p on every edge (aq x4, kc x4, hs, tk, kst) with the actual attention programme RTL over 36 link-slotted layers + a live fault phase (tools/qwen_static_kv/seq_static_s_bench.sh, Verilator 5.050); mutants in each child type: core (1), xs push (8), fan (9).

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; qkd_seq_static_s #(.MUT(0)) u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS -DOT_QKD_SEQ_STATIC_S_HARD --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/qwen_sys/static_kv_20261014/qkd_seq_static_s.sv && echo lint-ok

bench.name: seq_s_pass
bench.pass_regex: ^SEQ_S PASS layers=36 aq=4752 kc=\d+ hs=36 drn_toggles=\d+ errors=0 mut=0 lockstep_vs_p=every_edge

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/qkd_seq_static_s/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/qkd_seq_static_s/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/qkd_seq_static_s --out {RUN}/record/views/qkd_seq_static_s --macro-view physical/ref_tile/qkd_seq_core_st_s/views/qkd_seq_core_static_s --macro-view physical/ref_tile/qkd_seq_fan_s/views/qkd_seq_fan_s --macro-view physical/ref_tile/qkd_seq_xs_s/views/qkd_seq_xs_s > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: NEW cluster kit (OWN-QWEN/KV-PARENTS 10-18, tree K.STA.PARK): the die slot `seq` master qkd_seq_static_s (kv_static_die SEQ_S, kvs14p binds it) hardened over its 9 CLOSED children: core qkd_seq_core_st_s-c1-62789a1ed (TT +189.5 / FF +21.8), 4 x qkd_seq_xs_s-x1-9c9c3d7b5 (+155.4 / +19.4), 4 x qkd_seq_fan_s-f1-1d16a0569 (+326.8 / +18.1). Outline = the kvs14p die frame (SPLIT_FRAMES qkd_seq 604.8 x 475.2, LEF case_kv/elements.lef) and the frame's face per port (top-down pin assignment); W fans R0 / E fans MY with their aq faces on the die faces, the 2 x 2 Q-FIFO block MX (inputs toward the prg S face), core MX at the S face (prg / ar_h). Parent <= 0.61 mm a side and child insertions 102-168 ps: one balanced cluster spine with child-insertion leaf targets (not a landed parent: below the ~1 mm landed-regions threshold); judged by pin-flop spread at the child flops.
